title: Linear Model Contributions
learning_objectives: Attribute a linear prediction to features relative to a baseline
Verify that contributions sum to prediction − baseline prediction
Explain why the baseline choice matters
hints: Convert all inputs with `np.asarray(..., float)` and compare shapes.
`prediction = float(w @ x + b)`; baseline prediction similarly.

failure_feedback.advice: Contributions must be w * (x − baseline) so they sum to f(x) − f(baseline).
Return prediction and baseline_prediction as floats including the bias.
At the baseline every contribution is zero.
Validate that all vectors have the same length.
